content.short: Platform of tools that will bring extra utilities to NFTs and other assets, both in the virtual and real world.
content.description:
We want NFTs to be not just collectible arts and that the ADA is not just a cryptocurrency for trading in brokers, but that they are used in different scenarios and sectors with different functionalities.

On the platform, users who have one of our NFTs, will be able to have full and lifetime access to the project by creating and activating their adzID, access to all the tools that we will develop now and in the future within the platform forever, participate (vote) in the decisions related to the development of tools, choice of campaigns and humanitarian initiatives to be supported in the future, among other functions, discount on the purchase of NFTs that will be launched in the future, in partnership with institutions, companies, artists and much more.
